query:
SELECT 
  p.id,
  p.name,
  SUM(CAST(r.totalAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2)) - CAST(r.receivedAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as pendingAmount
FROM partners p
INNER JOIN receivables r ON p.id = r.customerId
WHERE r.status IN ('PENDENTE', 'PARCIAL', 'VENCIDO')
  AND p.active = 1
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
HAVING pendingAmount > 0
ORDER BY pendingAmount DESC
LIMIT 10
